notable_claims: Broad newsgroup bans are easily bypassed using Gopher services.
Censorship based on keywords (e.g., alt.binar*) inadvertently blocks legitimate discussion groups like fine art.
classification.summary: Thomas C. Mobley criticizes the censorship of Usenet newsgroups at the University of Waterloo. He argues that broad blocks on categories like alt.sex* and alt.binar* are counterproductive, as users bypass these bans via Gopher, potentially increasing network congestion.
classification.title: Re: Waterloo relaxing newsgroup ban ...
